pages.name: purchase-order-review
pages.after: (async()=>{for(let i=0;i<40&&!document.querySelector('h1');i++)await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200));const dismiss=[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b=>b.textContent?.trim()==='Not now');if(dismiss){dismiss.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800));const main=document.querySelector('main');return {path:location.pathname,h1:document.querySelector('h1')?.textContent,hasCommercial:/Commercial terms/.test(main?.innerText||''),hasInspection:/SGS pre-shipment inspection/.test(main?.innerText||''),hasTax:/Tax is calculated separately at checkout/.test(main?.innerText||''),hasSignature:/Electronic acceptance/.test(main?.innerText||''),rawKeys:/rfq\.po\./.test(main?.innerText||''),mainOverflow:main?main.scrollWidth>main.clientWidth+1:null}})()
